_comment: Canonical v0 recipe example: short hackathon clip showcase for Instagram Reels.
_comment3: User request: 'I have a clip of my hackathon project. Make it a polished social video with a quick intro, captions, branding, and an outro.'
request_summary: Hackathon progress clip with branding, captions, and CTA for Instagram Reels

sections.intent: Establish brand identity and set an energetic tone before the demo begins

asset.label: Brand identity frame — logo on primary palette

sections.visual_treatment: Primary palette background with animated logo reveal and accent pulse
sections.remotion_hint: logo animates in with scale 0.5→1 over 20f; brand name in bold white above logo; accent colour underline grows left→right 15–30f; no distracting background motion

sections.intent: Show the hackathon demo in full — this is the core evidence the viewer came for
sections.visual_treatment: Full-width clip fill with lower-third overlays; dark text bar at bottom for caption beats; accent colour text
sections.animation_direction: none — clip plays at full pace
sections.remotion_hint: OffthreadVideo fills AbsoluteFill; lower-third bar fades in at beat timing; caption text in accent colour on semi-transparent dark bar (0.75 opacity); bar slides up from bottom on appear

sections.intent: Land the achievement — what was built, key metrics, and how far it got
sections.visual_treatment: Dark background with centred bold text; accent highlight on key words; subtle upward drift animation

sections.intent: Drive the viewer to follow the account and check out the project
sections.visual_treatment: Full-screen primary palette background; handle in large white text; accent button-style border pulse on handle
